answer_verbatim: Use Option 1 (used up at new growing points). A released gamma carrier is absorbed where a new growing point forms at a qualifying frontier site that passes the local allow/require gate, giving new growing points a native trigger while preventing unabsorbed carriers from piling up and leaving grown material half-written.
decision: A released gamma carrier is absorbed where a new growth point forms, at a qualifying frontier site that passes the local ALLOW/REQUIRE gate. This is the native trigger for PD-15.
